svg.text: Lifted from the two high-level designs, where it sits inside each diagram.
business logic — the work the node exists to do
controller — composition, and the edges it drives
interface — a seam another component realizes
artifact — a file on disk, not a running part
test equipment — stands in for a real node
outside the node — another blueprint node
realization: the component implements the interface above it
A rounded navy frame is a «node» of the R5 blueprint; a grey frame is a node outside it.
A dashed component is test equipment standing in for another node's real image during a test.
